notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Engine Update

Updated Unreal Engine from 5.5 to 5.6

Optimizations

 General performance optimizations across all Found Footage levels for smoother gameplay.

Networking

 Complete overhaul of the connection system
 The new system is significantly more stable and should prevent players from being randomly disconnected or kicked.
 Introduced a brand new VOIP system designed to work seamlessly with the updated connection backend.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with the Skin Stealer’s voice playback inside the Prison level, which was incorrectly duplicating or missing lines.
 Fixed an issue where the in-game escape menu didn’t appear after changing maps, and the inventory was invisible to clients.

Other

 DLSS has been temporarily disabled; I’m just waiting for an update from NVIDIA to reintegrate it.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Minor Update - Optimisation
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today’s update is a small one but with a big impact!

I've done another optimization pass on all the story maps, and you should notice a solid improvement in FPS across each of these levels.

General Improvements:


 Reduced VRAM usage
 Shader optimizations
 Fewer draw calls
 Various other performance tweaks


I’m also aware of a crash affecting some AMD graphics cards. I’ll be working on a fix for that and aim to include it in an update later this week.

As always, feel free to report any issues you encounter and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: The Prison Level Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Patch Notes :

New Content:

Prison Level Is Out! : Step into the all new Prison level! Navigate tight corridors, locked cells, and high security zones in one of our most intense environments yet.

New Features:

 DLSS Support: NVIDIA DLSS is now supported for improved performance and visual quality.
 Show FPS Option: You can now toggle an FPS counter in the settings menu.
 Skin Stealer : The Skin Stealer is now accessible directly within the level editor.


Bug Fixes & Improvements:

 Overall Game Optimization: General performance and stability enhancements.
 Microphone Settings Bug Fix: Resolved an issue where microphone settings would not save or apply correctly.
 Item Drop on Death Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where items would incorrectly drop upon player death.
 Gamepad/Keyboard Assignment Bug Fix: Corrected input assignment issues when switching between gamepad and keyboard.
 Recorded Video Saving Fix: In-game recordings are now saved properly without corruption or loss.

notes.title: Minor Update - Optimization & New Features
notes.content:
Upgrade: The game has been updated to Unreal Engine 5.5 for better stability and performance.

Upcoming map in progress! I’ve completed a major part of the new map, and I’ll be back by the end of next week to share some screenshots! 

Thanks for your support, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Minor Update

notes.title: 🛠️ New Update Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I'm back with a fresh update bringing improvements, bug fixes, and exciting new features. Here’s what’s new:

🔧 Bug Fixes


 Fixed Create Lobby button now properly disables after clicking to prevent multiple lobbies from being created.
 Fixed a bug where moving forward while controlling the drone caused unexpected issues.
 Fixed an issue where all objects fell in the same direction.
 Fixed audio effects disappearing when zooming with the camera.
 Fixed a Steam Deck crash occurring when using the camera.
 Fixed Persian autowrap issue on tooltip interaction for the flashlight.


🎨 Level Editor Improvements


 Custom Player Start & Game Settings: Creators can now tweak certain game rules to customize the experience. (More settings will be added over time!)
 Custom Player Spawn Points: You can now define specific spawn points for players in the editor.
 New Level Asset: Added a damaged roof for Level 0 inside the level editor.
 

⚙️ Gameplay & Balancing Changes


 Inventory UI Rework: The inventory now features item icons for improved clarity.
 Multiplayer Bacteria Adjustments:
 Reduced the stroboscopic effect when repulsing it.
 Slightly decreased its walking speed.
 New Item: Defibrillator! ⚡ Be careful how you use it!

…And many more small tweaks and improvements!

🛠️ I appreciate your feedback! Try out the update and let us know what you think in the comments or on our community hub.

Join our community on Discord to share your feedback and connect with other players! 👉 DISCORD

Enjoy the game! 🚀

 Fixed: The "Remove On" property has been removed for the Pool Sink item.
 Fixed: Ceiling pattern lights no longer intersect with the ceiling.
 Fixed: Some objects could not be modified after saving/reopening.
 Fixed: Some objects disappeared after saving/reopening.
 Fixed: Level 0 Thin Cross changed position after saving and playing.
 Fixed: Level 0 Thin Cross had a hidden side in its geometry.
 Fixed: Level 0 Medium Cross also had a hidden side in its geometry.

 - Game & Workshop


 Fixed: UV Flashlight Inventory Item slot Missing Icon.
 Fixed: The cart driving input key was not properly linked to the custom input settings, preventing players from remapping controls.
 Fixed: Poolrooms, bacteria stuck behind a wall
 Fixed: Players could fly after using the waterslide in co-op mode.
 Fixed: Infinite loading issue for large Workshop maps.

notes.title: Gameplay Balancing Update
notes.content:
Hey,

Sorry for spamming with updates, but it’s me again! After the last patch for balancing entities, some players told me the game became almost unbeatable. 

So, I’ve decided to work on it and tweak a few things. I’ve adjusted entity decision-making and behavior, improved strobe reactivity to repel them, and reworked the main path in the poolrooms, especially the part with the vehicles.

I hope the game feels more balanced now! Don’t hesitate to share your feedback on the community hub or right here in this thread. Have fun!

notes.title: Announcement & Update 0.03
notes.content:
- Announcement


 In the coming week (plus or minus a few days), I have two major updates lined up.
 The first update will introduce the foundation of the level editor (alpha version), allowing you to create and share your maps via the Steam Workshop. Every workshop map will be playable in multiplayer.
 Following shortly after, the next update will unveil the next solo found footage of the series.

 Addressed multiplayer multi-region connection issues.

 Added an option to enable/disable hardware ray tracing (RTX), which may resolve some lighting issues experienced with certain AMD graphics cards.
